g.text: ACS712 5A: 15k/20k divider maps nominal 1.575-3.425V (±5A) to ~0.90-1.96V. Verify module variant, calibration and pump startup current; divider reduces ADC span.

g.desc: ACS712 5A: 15k/20k divider maps nominal 1.575-3.425V (±5A) to ~0.90-1.96V. Verify module variant, calibration and pump startup current; divider reduces ADC span.

g.text: Use a motor-rated external contactor/protection for the pump. Relay command is not shutdown feedback. Voltage sensing is low-voltage DC only.

g.desc: Use a motor-rated external contactor/protection for the pump. Relay command is not shutdown feedback. Voltage sensing is low-voltage DC only.

g.text: Analog module outputs use 15k series / 20k to GND dividers (0-5V -> <2.9V with 1% resistors). Use only after confirming module maximum output.

g.desc: Analog module outputs use 15k series / 20k to GND dividers (0-5V -> <2.9V with 1% resistors). Use only after confirming module maximum output.

g.text: R1-R8: 15k/20k 1% dividers (confirmed 0-5V outputs only); R9: DS18B20 pull-up; R10-R13 + Q1: inverting flow conditioner.

g.desc: R1-R8: 15k/20k 1% dividers (confirmed 0-5V outputs only); R9: DS18B20 pull-up; R10-R13 + Q1: inverting flow conditioner.

g.text: 5V INPUT: regulated external 5V supply to ESP32 VIN and modules. Do not route pump power through this logic PCB.

g.desc: 5V INPUT: regulated external 5V supply to ESP32 VIN and modules. Do not route pump power through this logic PCB.

g.text: AURAPUMP - ESP32 PUMP AND FARM SENSOR INTERFACE

g.desc: AURAPUMP - ESP32 PUMP AND FARM SENSOR INTERFACE

g.text: LOW-VOLTAGE CONTROL BOARD | DevKit V1 30-pin header mapping shown as a draft; verify the exact board before PCB layout.

g.desc: LOW-VOLTAGE CONTROL BOARD | DevKit V1 30-pin header mapping shown as a draft; verify the exact board before PCB layout.

g.text: RELAY_IN startup state is unresolved until module active level is identified. Do not operate relay/pump from this draft; select correct inactive bias/interface after verification.

g.desc: RELAY_IN startup state is unresolved until module active level is identified. Do not operate relay/pump from this draft; select correct inactive bias/interface after verification.

g.text: J2 pins 1/2/4/7/8/14 = VIN/GND/GPIO22/GPIO21/GND/GPIO4. Confirm exact board pin order and polarity before connecting; J1/J2 footprints intentionally blank.

g.desc: J2 pins 1/2/4/7/8/14 = VIN/GND/GPIO22/GPIO21/GND/GPIO4. Confirm exact board pin order and polarity before connecting; J1/J2 footprints intentionally blank.

g.text: DRAFT COMMON 30-pin DevKit map: J1 pins 3/5/6/7/8 = GPIO36/34/35/32/33 ADC; J1 pins 10/11 = GPIO26 relay / GPIO27 flow.

g.desc: DRAFT COMMON 30-pin DevKit map: J1 pins 3/5/6/7/8 = GPIO36/34/35/32/33 ADC; J1 pins 10/11 = GPIO26 relay / GPIO27 flow.

g.text: J4 voltage sensor output must be verified <=5V before using divider. DC isolated sensing only; never connect mains. Relay input active polarity/startup state requires exact module validation before use.

g.desc: J4 voltage sensor output must be verified <=5V before using divider. DC isolated sensing only; never connect mains. Relay input active polarity/startup state requires exact module validation before use.
